questions.question: Which of the following is an example of a B2C E-Commerce website?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Amazon sells directly to individual consumers, which is B2C. Alibaba is mainly B2B, and Google is a search/services company.

questions.question: ........ is a combination of hardware and software that facilitates the sharing of information between computing devices.
questions.explanation: A network is a combination of hardware and software that lets computing devices share information and resources. A peripheral is just an attached input/output device.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a common type of E-Commerce model?
questions.explanation: B2C, C2B and C2C are all recognized e-commerce models (along with B2B), so none of the options is NOT a model.

questions.question: _____ command makes the updates performed by the transaction permanent in the database.

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: COMMIT makes all changes made by the current transaction permanent. ROLLBACK undoes them, and TRUNCATE is a DDL command that removes all rows.

questions.question: A ________ (invented by Paul Roget in 1828) is a simple mechanical toy which creates the illusion of movement.
questions.explanation: A thaumatrope is a disc with different pictures on each side; spinning it on strings merges the images into one, illustrating persistence of vision. The zoetrope is a later rotating drum device.

questions.question: What is the main purpose of the Data Link Control in the data link layer?
questions.explanation: Data link control handles framing, flow control and error control between adjacent nodes; framing (packaging bits into frames) is its basic function. Routing is a network layer job and encryption is not a DLC function.

questions.question: A set of libraries that provides programmatically access to some kind of graphics 2D functions is

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: A graphics package is a set of libraries giving programmatic access to 2D graphics functions such as drawing lines, shapes and filling regions.

questions.question: When the mail server sends mail to other mail servers it becomes

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: When a mail server forwards mail to another mail server, it initiates the SMTP connection and therefore acts as an SMTP client.

questions.question: Which among the following is not true about IoT?
questions.explanation: IoT devices are often vulnerable to attacks, so the claim that IoT is fully safe is false. The other statements (microcontrollers, sensors and actuators, wireless technology) are true.

questions.question: Which of the following is known as a set of entities of the same type that share same properties, or attributes?
questions.explanation: An entity set is a collection of entities of the same type sharing the same attributes. A relationship set groups relationships, and tuples are rows of a relation.

questions.question: The term "FAT" is stands for_____
questions.explanation: FAT stands for File Allocation Table, the table recording which clusters belong to each file. It is a table, not a tree or graph.

questions.question: Which component of an ideal microcomputer is responsible for temporarily holding data and instructions during processing?
questions.explanation: The memory (main memory) temporarily stores the data and instructions while a program is being processed. The CPU and ALU process data, and output devices only present results.

questions.question: A photograph is an analog image and a _____ can convert it into a digital image.
questions.explanation: A scanner digitizes an existing printed photograph into a digital image. A printer does the reverse.

questions.question: Which network topology requires a central controller or hub?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: In a star topology every node connects to a central hub or controller. Mesh and ring topologies have no central device.

questions.question: Private key cryptography is also known as _____ cryptography.
questions.explanation: In private (secret) key cryptography the same key is used to encrypt and decrypt, so it is symmetric. Public key cryptography is asymmetric.

questions.question: Which of the following is not a valid aggregate function?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: COUNT and SUM are standard SQL aggregate functions, while COMPUTE is not an aggregate function.

questions.question: When a key is pressed on keyboard, which standard is used for converting the keystroke into the corresponding bits?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Keyboards encode keystrokes using ASCII codes. EBCDIC is an IBM mainframe code and ANSI is a standards body, not the keyboard character code.

questions.question: The correct statement for a function that takes pointer to a float, a pointer to a pointer to a char and returns a pointer to a pointer to an integer is

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Return type pointer to pointer to int is int **, the first parameter pointer to float is float *, and the second pointer to pointer to char is char **, giving int **fun(float *, char **).

questions.question: Which of the following is a type of operating system?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Real-time, embedded and network operating systems are all recognized types of operating systems.

questions.question: You can add a date to a document by

options.B: Inserting a date field that will update automatically

questions.explanation: A date can be typed manually, inserted as static text, or inserted as a field that updates automatically (Insert > Date and Time), so all are possible.

questions.question: _____ data type is used to implement Queue data structure in Python.
questions.explanation: A list is ordered and mutable, so elements can be appended at the rear and removed with pop(0) at the front. Tuples are immutable, and sets/dictionaries do not maintain a FIFO order of arbitrary items.

questions.question: Which of the following refers to creating products tailored to individual customers?
questions.explanation: Customization means building or tailoring a product to an individual customer's requirements, a key e-commerce capability. Adaptation is a general change, and auction is a pricing mechanism.

questions.question: A language for which a DFA exists is a:
questions.explanation: A language is regular if and only if some DFA (equivalently NFA or regular expression) accepts it.

questions.question: AI is about
questions.explanation: AI is the science of making machines intelligent, able to reason, learn and solve problems. Playing games is only one application.

questions.question: What is the time complexity of an infix to postfix conversion algorithm?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Each symbol of the infix expression is scanned once and pushed and popped from the stack at most once, so the conversion runs in O(N) time.
